categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, sales, and service of fiber optic gyro core components, fiber optic coils, and related comprehensive solutions. Its product portfolio includes fiber optic coil devices, specialty optical fibers, new materials, high-end equipment, specialty cables, and other related products. The company serves both military and civilian markets, focusing on inertial navigation, marine defense, industrial lasers, medical treatment, and optical communications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in specialty optical fiber design and simulation, preform manufacturing, fiber drawing, coating materials, microstructured fiber design and manufacturing, fiber coil winding and testing, integrated photonic chip technology, laser application technology, and intelligent winding platform engineering. It has developed integrated production capabilities covering the entire fiber optic coil supply chain, including 'coil-fiber-adhesive-module-equipment'. Advanced manufacturing methods include automated fiber winding, UV and thermal curing adhesives, and precision coating technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are military research institutes and defense enterprises, with products widely used in tactical weapons, strategic missiles, military aircraft, naval vessels, armored vehicles, spacecraft, and rockets. The company also serves civilian sectors such as industrial laser manufacturing, medical devices, telecommunications, energy exploration, and transportation. It actively expands into international markets through distributors and direct sales to strategic customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and major production facilities in Wuhan. It has subsidiaries in Beijing, Hebei, Hainan, and other regions. The company is expanding its international presence through overseas exhibitions, online platforms, and building overseas sales and service teams to serve global customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the upstream to midstream segments of the fiber optic industry, including raw material preparation (specialty fibers), component manufacturing (fiber optic coils and modules), and equipment production (fiber drawing towers, winding machines). It also extends downstream by providing integrated photonic chips and system-level solutions for inertial navigation and optical communication.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on three growth curves: consolidating sensing with fiber optic gyro solutions and fiber optic hydrophone systems; expanding power transmission with specialty fibers for fiber lasers; and developing thermal management and next-generation optical communication solutions including AI data center support. R&D priorities include microstructured fibers, integrated photonic chips, laser applications, intelligent manufacturing platforms, and advanced materials such as phase change materials for thermal control. The company integrates AI technologies into R&D and production to enhance innovation and efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of fiber optic coils, specialty optical fibers, new materials, optical devices, and related equipment. The company also earns income from technical and engineering services related to these products. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales contracts with military and civilian customers, supplemented by distributor networks for international markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier in the fiber optic coil and specialty fiber market, recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise. It competes with global firms such as Corning, Fujikura, Furukawa, and LEONI in specialty fiber segments. The company holds a strong position in the military inertial navigation supply chain and is expanding its footprint in civilian and international markets through technology innovation and integrated supply chain capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 330.76 million, a 50.22% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 17.94 million, up 15.28%. Total assets reached RMB 1.49 billion, growing 8.36%, with net assets of RMB 1.17 billion. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by increased military orders and expanded civilian applications, despite some fluctuations in cash flow due to increased raw material purchases and slower customer payments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated 'coil-fiber-adhesive-module-equipment' micro-industry chain, proprietary core technologies, and high product quality and reliability, especially for military-grade inertial navigation applications. Its products offer high precision, stability, and environmental adaptability, with capabilities in customized fiber designs and advanced manufacturing processes. The company also differentiates through its strategic focus on AI-enabled intelligent manufacturing, comprehensive thermal management solutions, and expanding applications in emerging fields such as AI data centers and next-generation optical communications.
